detail.longDescription: ansible-jailexec 2.0.3 is out: a security release for the Ansible connection plugin that runs tasks inside FreeBSD jails via jexec. Files pushed into a jail were staged in /tmp on the jail host with the source file's mode (often 0644), so other local users on the host could read them during the transfer. Staging now uses a private 0700 directory. Thanks to GitHub: manus-pi for the report! Advisory: https:// github.com/chofstede/ansible_j ailexec/security/advisories/GHSA-cfm5-946c-m3qx # FreeBSD # Ansible # Security # DevOps
